text:
My theory about Flawless Sparklemoon.
Princess Trixibelle used to rule Equestria as the one and only princess—until Princess Celestia and Princess Luna overthrew her. Back then, Princess Trixibelle was basically the court jester who somehow grabbed the throne.
Trixi Lulamoon is her direct descendant. In the movie " The Death of Twilight Sparkle", we learn that Trixi Lulamoon is a unicorn who literally fuses the personality and magic of two different unicorns.
From that, we can conclude that Flawless Sparklemoon isn’t just a mash-up of Trixi Lulamoon + Twilight Sparkle—she’s actually three ponies in one trench coat: Trixi, Twilight, AND ancient Princess Trixibelle.
Because Flawless Sparklemoon is such a chaotic magical fusion, it accidentally woke up Princess Trixibelle’s consciousness from a thousand years ago. The opening credits of the movie "SWEETIE BELLE IN LOVE" basically spell it out: Princess Trixibelle is coming back to reclaim the magic that rightfully belongs to her bloodline—which means she’s gonna straight-up murder Trixi Lulamoon. Once Trixi’s out of the picture, Princess Trixibelle will seize full control of Flawless Sparklemoon’s body.
We even get her new name: Flawless Sparklemoon will literally just be called “Flatulence” from that point on.
Her endgame? Simple—take back the throne and rule Equestria again, this time forever.
